description: Get a shareable page for one finished call, in the business's own branding: the customer-safe recap, next steps and what the caller picked (never notes, recordings or scoring). Returns a link to share, an embed_url for an iframe, and a ready-to-paste embed_html snippet. Each request makes a fresh link that works for 30 days.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token has exactly one accessible business)

call_id.description: KaiCalls call id, the voice provider's call id, or "latest" for the business's most recent finished call

name: get_call_page
title: Get Call Page
